items.text: List workspace and inspect input file metadata
Sample/classify initial reads with remote BLAST
Download human transcriptome and map reads to isolate non-human/unmapped
Classify unmapped reads to identify contaminant genus
Verify answer and produce exact one-line output

item.command: /bin/bash -lc 'curl -L --fail -o Homo_sapiens.GRCh38.cdna.all.fa.gz https://ftp.ensembl.org/pub/release-113/fasta/homo_sapiens/cdna/Homo_sapiens.GRCh38.cdna.all.fa.gz && ls -lh Homo_sapiens.GRCh38.cdna.all.fa.gz'
